However, Vivek Ramaswamy is clearly the frontrunner - he has raised nearly $20 million (compared to minimal funds for Putsch), received the Ohio Republican Party endorsement in May 2025, and has endorsements from Trump and major unions. Putsch is described as a 'political newcomer' with no significant fundraising or endorsements mentioned. The evidence strongly suggests Ramaswamy will win the primary.
